input_files: file-backed fixture: optional UTF-8 task package supplied through --task-file
output_contract: Codex App URL and CLI resume command
allowed_writes: job receipts and logs under CODEX_EXTERNAL_HANDOFF_HOME or CODEX_HOME/external-handoff
temporary request file under the same local state root, deleted immediately after worker startup
workspace files only when the caller explicitly selects workspace-write and the task package names the permitted paths
forbidden_writes: canonical project state during default read-only research or review
paths outside an explicitly authorized workspace-write task package
remote inline code or downloaded executables
rollback_boundary: Remove the installed skill directory; local Codex threads and rollout history remain untouched.

file_write.scope: Local job receipts, logs, one transient request file, and explicitly authorized workspace-write task targets.
file_write.reason: Background supervision requires recoverable local receipts; the request file prevents task text from appearing in process arguments.

target_enforcement.openai: Not a packaged target; the local CLI wrapper still enforces the same sandbox enum and task contract
target_enforcement.claude: Skill contract plus CLI sandbox enum
target_enforcement.generic: CLI sandbox enum and task-package permission contract
target_enforcement.vscode: Not a packaged target; the local CLI wrapper still enforces the same sandbox enum and task contract

subprocess.scope: Launch local Python worker, local codex app-server, and macOS open for codex:// URLs.
subprocess.reason: Persistent background Codex Threads require a supervised local App Server process and optional App handoff.

target_enforcement.openai: Not a packaged target; fixed local executable allowlist remains enforced by the wrapper
target_enforcement.claude: Only fixed local executables are launched; task text is never used as a shell command
target_enforcement.generic: Only fixed local executables are launched; task text is passed through App Server JSONL
target_enforcement.vscode: Not a packaged target; fixed local executable allowlist remains enforced by the wrapper
